documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its new 10-acre automated Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial growth for the quarter and full year, driven by the shift towards in-house manufacturing of textile binders and table gues under a technology transfer agreement. The company aims to scale manufacturing capacity utilization to 100% by the end of FY27, increase the manufacturing share of revenue mix towards 50%, and expand product applications into non-textile industries like paints and coatings. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26 in its investor presentation. Management highlighted the successful commissioning of a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, marking a strategic shift from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins can increase by 200 to 300 basis points overall.
guidance.quote: If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity of 500 tons per month by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing margins can be expected to reach near about 50% according to production.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: Total turnover from manufacturing at full utilization with 500-ton capacity will come to around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Management maintains the top-line guidance of closing around INR 110 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: Prateek Chaudhary: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed? Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces various challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally with expected growth of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in wood coating.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: New machinery is being added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has further scope to expand manufacturing capacity by putting up vessels costing INR3 crore to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant and 500 tons per month capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process with a zero-carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Utilities, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity have already been installed for future expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing facility was funded through a INR 30 crores bank loan, INR 10 crores from the IPO for land purchase, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
Q3 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% from 9.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q3 rose by 117.4% to INR 4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving by 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

margins_costs.claim: Reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% following the start of manufacturing for two products.
margins_costs.quote: We are still importing the rest of the products. We are importing wood coating as well. But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at present at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new Vadodara manufacturing plant is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first 2 months (November and December) after starting manufacturing, capacity utilization was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: As of December end, the company's net worth stood at around INR 42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The interest rate applicable on the company's short-term borrowings is 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: Scaling manufacturing utilization remains a key priority for FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, the company's vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: Management outlined plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve full plant capacity by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a fully manufacturing unit by 2030 and try to become a market leader.
management_commitments.quote: See, we will establish fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030. And try to become a market leader by giving sustainable eco-friendly solution to the textile as well as the wood coating industry.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
